text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what actually happened.

The wins were practical. Reps cut post-meeting admin from about 40 minutes to 10. CRM updates were more complete, and follow-up emails went out the same day instead of two days later.

The surprises were human. Customers asked about recording more than we expected, so we started every call with a clear consent line. Trust went up, not down.

The misses: summaries missed tone, like hesitation or a quiet "we'll see." Reps still had to add that judgment.

Our takeaway: AI handles the record. Reps own the read.

What has your team learned from your own pilots?
